timing: after inspection of archived outputs and prospective repeatability results
reason: The project has no feasible human-validation capacity; the publication question is narrowed to properties identifiable without external truth labels.
supersedes_for_current_manuscript: RQ2 human-referenced screening and extraction validity
RQ3 evaluator validity and controlled error injection
RQ4 calibrated error propagation and pooled meta-analysis
retained_as_archived_not_planned: human-reference sample manifests and reviewer packets
new_primary_question: Which data-quality properties of an LLM-assisted evidence-synthesis workflow are observable and identifiable without external reference labels, and how do denominator rules, fallback-state collisions, provenance gaps, interface conformance, and output representation affect those measurements?
model_boundary: Historical screening used the declared alias gpt-4.1-mini; historical extraction and evaluation used gpt-4o-mini. The later 2,100-successful-call repeatability experiment used gpt-5-mini with different prompts and strict schemas and must be reported as a separate prospective experiment on frozen historical inputs, not as repeatability of the historical models.
configuration_boundary: The prospective client requested temperature=0 and the endpoint accepted the requests; retained responses do not verify the effective server-side decoding configuration, so the manuscript will report observed same-request repeatability rather than nominally deterministic behavior.
analysis_change: Raw exact matching is demoted to a strict sensitivity measure for free-text categorical values. Primary repeatability summaries separate all-null, mixed-null, and all-non-null items and include deterministic normalization, token-set matching, and threshold sensitivity. No semantic correctness is inferred.
repository_policy: No historical files or original frozen protocol decisions are deleted. This append-only amendment governs the current no-human-validation manuscript.
